about: Pauses lengthened inside a finished voice line so it matches the mouth in a generated shot. after_word counts from 0. start_shift moves the line's start, in frames.

mara8.why: In Mara's reel the pause between 'Yeah' and 'It is' is four frames longer than in the finished line. The line starts four frames sooner so 'It is' stays where it was.
